question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Programe"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is** "Program"**. (कार्यक्रम)

 
 
• **Example:** The new software** program** will be launched next month.
 
 
 
• **"Program"** refers to a planned series of events, activities, or procedures. (कार्यक्रम)
 
 
• **Example:** The school has a special **program **for gifted students.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct spelling is **"Program"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unexpected** (अप्रत्याशित): Something that was not anticipated or predicted.

 
 
• **Example:** The sudden rain was completely **unexpected.**
 
 
 
• **Pilgrimage** (तीर्थयात्रा): A journey to a sacred place for religious reasons.
 
 
• **Example:** Every year, thousands of people undertake the **pilgrimage **to Mecca.
 
 
 
• **Campaign** (अभियान): An organized effort to achieve a particular goal, typically a political or social one.
 
 
• **Example:** The **campaign** to save the environment has gained a lot of support.
 
 

5b:Td78,

The correct answer is **Option 1)**
